blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announced on Thursday that 4,165 out of 4,447 (93.66%) examinees successfully passed the October 2026 Physicians Licensure Examination. Who made it to the top 10? Maxine Francesco Gwyneth Cena Baculo of the University of Santo Tomas (UST) topped the PLE with a rating of 95.50%. READ: Calapan City resident tops October 2026 physician licensure exam Baculo led the 10 highest-ranking examinees in the licensure examination, followed by three University of the Philippines (UP)-Manila graduates who placed second, third, and fourth.
